name: info
description: A circular information mark with a clear dot gap.
useCase: Present an informational note beside readable text.
misuse: Do not use a decorative info mark as the only access to help.

16.reason: The full-size dot moves upward to leave more than 1px before the stem and circular frame without shrinking the information mark.

24.reason: The original dot and stem retain at least 1.5px of space inside the unchanged circular keyline.
